hypothesis: The fixed 50000-row mixed ranking cohort may offer too little same-reading, different-source-form supervision to learn contextual discrimination; representation or identical-input conflicts are alternative explanations to measure.
metrics: baseline source-correct and target rank distribution
reading groups and literal target diversity
in-sample reading-majority oracle, explicitly not test performance
character hash aliases and within-row candidate token aliases
supervision coverage of already exposed #40/#41 research targets
scope: Descriptive diagnosis only. No model inference, optimization, new data admission, old dev/final Test access, vocabulary change or label mutation. Surface variants need not have different meanings. Hash aliases alone do not prove ranking harm.
verification: Join authenticated training metadata to immutable raw rows; verify every context/reading/positive target encoding; replay grouped summaries in reverse order and independent scalar counts. No raw text in report/log/Git.
follow_up: Use measured signal gaps to specify the next data-acquisition or teacher diagnostic. Do not start a new fit from these results.
